prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: charcoal. Texture family: rough fibrous charcoal paper with weathered concrete-like grain, soft soot bloom, rubbed graphite haze, and restrained water-stain mottling. Palette: desaturated storm gray, soot black, concrete beige, oxidized blue-green, dead moss green, dirty ivory, and sparse cold amber remnants for failing artificial light. Line treatment: cinematic charcoal silhouettes with broken architectural edges, selective crisp dark contours around important infrastructure, loose rubbed shading in decay zones, and fine scratch marks for cables, weeds, cracks, and rain. Lighting: overcast cinematic daylight shifting into dim emergency-light gloom, with long soft shadows, misty atmospheric falloff, and occasional isolated cold-amber utility glow. Avoid: no photorealism, no glossy 3D CGI, no anime, no neon cyberpunk, no clean vector infographic aesthetic, no cheerful storybook treatment, no excessive gore or animal suffering, no disaster-movie fireball spectacle, no dense technical labels, no visible text or UI inside world imagery, and no beat-by-beat medium switching. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism.
